verdict: Only for a well-funded founder. Rock Paper Rum pitched an Indian craft rum on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Indian craft spirits are having a moment, but licensing, excise duties, distillery tie-ups and the advertising ban make this one of the slowest businesses to build.
angle: Premium Indian gin, rum and whisky brands have grown fast among urban drinkers who want local stories. You'll need a distillery to make it for you, state-by-state label approvals, and distributors. Bars and word of mouth are the main channels.
